top_signals.title: Bond Market’s ‘Extreme’ Short Counts on Fed to Deliver Rate Hike
top_signals.summary: Bond traders have piled into bearish positions ahead of Wednesday’s Federal Reserve meeting, betting that the Treasury selloff driving yields to their highest levels in over a decade will continue.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
